params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} Upon {{tip|death|dying}}, {{ci|Karthus}} enters an {{tip|untargetable}} {{tip|Zombie state|spirit form}} for a few seconds that allows him to continue casting spells at no cost but without being able to move.
params.blurb2: If ''{{ai|Defile|Karthus}}'' has been learned, it will remain toggled on for ''Death Defied's'' entire duration.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Upon taking {{tip|death|fatal damage}}, '''Karthus''' enters a '''{{tip|zombie state}}''' for 7 seconds, during which he can cast his abilities at no cost. If ''{{ai|Defile|Karthus}}'' has been learned, it will remain toggled on for ''Death Defied's'' entire duration. ''{{ai|Requiem|Karthus}}'' becomes disabled after 4 seconds of the duration have elapsed.
params.description2: While under this state, '''Karthus''' becomes {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}} as well as prevents all incoming damage, but is also rendered unable to move, declare {{tip|basic attacks}}, use [[summoner spell]]s, and [[Active ability items|activate items]].
params.notes:
* ''Death Defied's'' {{tip|untargetability}} does not {{tip|homing projectile destruction|destroy}} in-flight {{tip|projectiles}}.
* '''Karthus''' cannot be {{tip|execute|executed}} by the {{bi|Aspect of the Dragon}} during ''Death Defied''.
* At the start of ''Death Defied'', '''Karthus''' is set to {{sti|health|{{as|1 health}}}}.
** '''Karthus''' can still regenerate his health over the duration, but he will always die at the end of it.
* After ''Death Defied'' ends, the corpse of '''Karthus''' will retain [[unit collision]] despite being dead on the ground.
* '''Karthus' ''' [[health bar|mana bar]] drains over the duration of ''Death Defied'' as an indicator of his time remaining in this state.
{{Zombie state info}}

blurb.plain: Innate: Upon dying, Karthus enters an untargetable spirit form for a few seconds that allows him to continue casting spells at no cost but without being able to move.

blurb2.plain: If Defile has been learned, it will remain toggled on for Death Defied's entire duration.

description.plain: Innate: Upon taking fatal damage, Karthus enters a zombie state for 7 seconds, during which he can cast his abilities at no cost. If Defile has been learned, it will remain toggled on for Death Defied's entire duration. Requiem becomes disabled after 4 seconds of the duration have elapsed.

description2.plain: While under this state, Karthus becomes untargetable and immune to crowd control as well as prevents all incoming damage, but is also rendered unable to move, declare basic attacks, use summoner spells, and activate items.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Karthus}} erects a wall of pain at the target location that lasts a few seconds, enemies that touch it suffer reduced {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance}}}} and become {{tip|slow|slowed}} for a few seconds.

params.description2: Enemies that touch the wall are inflicted with {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|25% magic resistance reduction}}}} and become {{tip|slow|slowed}} for 5 seconds, decaying over the duration. This can affect enemies only once per cast.

params.blurb2: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Karthus''' surrounds himself in a necrotic [[aura]] that continually deals {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies, quickly draining his own {{sti|mana}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Karthus''' restores {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} whenever he kills an enemy.
params.description2: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Karthus''' surrounds himself in a necrotic [[aura]] that deals {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to all nearby enemies.
params.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|30/4 to 110/4}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}}|Damage Per Second|{{ap|30 to 110}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}}}
params.description3: Toggling ''Defile'' off triggers a final tick of damage. ''Defile'' is toggled off automatically if '''Karthus''' becomes unable to pay its {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost.
params.description4: ''Defile cannot be toggled off during {{ai|Death Defied|Karthus}}.''
params.notes:
* Toggled abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* ''Defile'' will restore {{tip|mana}} if '''Karthus''' destroys an enemy structure.
* ''Defile'' re-calculates its damage with each tick based on changes in '''Karthus's''' {{as|ability power}} or an increase in the rank of ''Defile'' without the need to toggle it off and on again.
* ''Defile'' will toggle off automatically if '''Karthus''' enters {{tip|resurrection}}.
